params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch does not address the SonarQube warning about multiple variables declared on the same line. Instead, it removes a large portion of code unrelated to the warning and adds a single line declaring two variables on the same line, which is exactly what the warning advises against. This change is both unrelated and counterproductive to fixing the warning.
